publish_policy.description:
How finished pages for a publishing property leave RoboWrite.

``cms_publish`` (the default) auto-publishes a finished page to the
organization's connected CMS. Without a connected CMS, generation runs for
the property stop and wait for a person in the RoboWrite dashboard.

``draft_only`` means you collect finished pages yourself: runs complete on
their own, the page is downloaded with
``GET /api/public/v1/content/{content_item_id}``, and
``POST /api/public/v1/content/{item_id}/publish`` answers 409 because there
is no destination to publish to.
